segments.ja250:1.1: Ayaṃ isī upasamasaṃyame rato, sa tiṭṭhati [santiṭṭhati (sī. pī.)] sisirabhayena aṭṭito;
segments.ja250:1.3: Handa ayaṃ pavisatumaṃ agārakaṃ, vinetu sītaṃ darathañca kevalaṃ.
segments.ja250:2.1: Nāyaṃ isī upasamasaṃyame rato, kapī ayaṃ dumavarasākhagocaro;
segments.ja250:2.3: So dūsako rosako cāpi jammo, sacevajemampi [sace + āvaje + imampi] dūseyyagāranti [dūsaye gharanti (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja250:5.1: Atha rājā siṅgālavaro sunakho, tathā kosiya icchati kālaghaso;
segments.ja250:5.3: Atha dānavaroṭṭhapi sārathinā, punambavanañca sisirakapi dasāti.
segments.ja250:7.1: Daḷhañca vaggaṃ aparena santhavaṃ, kalyāṇavaggāsadiso ca rūhakaṃ;
segments.ja250:7.3: Nataṃdaḷha bīraṇathambhakaṃ puna, kāsāvupāhana siṅgālakena dasāti.
